title: Caribbean Green Seasoning

items: 2 inch of ginger (same volume as garlic)
15-20 leaves of shado beni (culantro) (Substitute with 2 bunches of cilantro)

steps: Roughly chop all ingredients and blend with a food processor using the pulse method until a rough puree.

relatedApplications.title: Grilled Chicken with honey glaze
relatedApplications.method: Combine marinade and chicken then refrigerate for 1-2 hours. Grill the chicken until nearly done then brush with the glaze and brown until set, about 1 minute per side.

ingredientGroups.title: Marinade
items: Salt and pepper (season the meat to taste as you normally would)

relatedApplications.title: Crispy potatoes
relatedApplications.method: Cut 1 lb yukon gold potatoes into ½-¾” chunks. Parboil until it just starts to get tender, around 10 minutes. Drain well and toss with ¼ cup caribbean green seasoning, ½ tsp crushed red pepper, and salt & pepper to taste. The shaking/tossing process should rough up the exterior to create a mashed potato texture on the outside. Pan fry or drizzle with olive oil and roast on a sheet pan for 40 minutes at 450F (400F convection), flipping halfway through.
